title: Connect Your Tools | Qubrid Documentation
markdown:
Hostname update:The Qubrid platform is now at qubrid.com. [Read the migration guide](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/inferencing/Migration)

Qubrid serverless models work with the tools you already use. Most integrations connect through Qubrid's **OpenAI-compatible API**, so you can point editors, agents, and chat UIs at `https://qubrid.com/v1` with your API key and start using hosted models without managing infrastructure.

If a tool is still configured with `https://platform.qubrid.com/v1`, update it to `https://qubrid.com/v1`. See [Platform Hostname Migration](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/inferencing/Migration).

Whether you code in an IDE, run a local agent, or chat in a self-hosted web UI, the guides below walk through setup step by step. Each page includes configuration details, troubleshooting, and links to the official tool documentation.

[Get your API key\\
\\
Generate a Qubrid API key before connecting any integration.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Manage%20API%20Keys#how-to-generate-an-api-key)

**What you need for most integrations**:

- A Qubrid account on the [Qubrid AI Platform](https://qubrid.com/)
- A Qubrid API key ( [how to generate an API key](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Manage%20API%20Keys#how-to-generate-an-api-key))
- **API base URL:** `https://qubrid.com/v1`
- Model IDs from [Serverless Models](https://qubrid.com/models) (case-sensitive)

## [How it works](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Connect%20Your%20Tools\#how-it-works)

Qubrid exposes serverless text and code models over a standard chat-completions API. Third-party tools that support **OpenAI-compatible** or **custom endpoint** providers can use Qubrid as the backend.

Typical setup:

1. Install or open the tool you want to use.
2. Add Qubrid as a provider with base URL `https://qubrid.com/v1`.
3. Paste your Qubrid API key.
4. Select a model (or let the tool discover models from the endpoint).
5. Start chatting or coding.

Some guides include **video tutorials** on the integration page. Model usage and costs appear in [Inference Logs](https://qubrid.com/inferencing-logs) on the Qubrid platform.

## [Code editors & IDEs](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Connect%20Your%20Tools\#code-editors--ides)

Use Qubrid models for inline assistance, chat, and agentic coding inside your editor.

[Cursor\\
\\
Add Qubrid as an OpenAI-compatible provider and select models from Cursor chat.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Cursor) [VS Code\\
\\
Register Qubrid as a custom Chat Completions endpoint in the language model picker.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/VS%20Code) [Zed\\
\\
Connect Zed to Qubrid through the OpenAI-compatible model provider settings.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Zed) [Claude Code\\

## [AI agents & assistants](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Connect%20Your%20Tools\#ai-agents--assistants)

Run autonomous or multi-channel assistants backed by Qubrid models.

[Hermes\\
\\
Install Hermes Agent and connect to Qubrid via the full setup wizard. Chat from the CLI or messaging apps.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Hermes) [OpenClaw\\
\\
Onboard OpenClaw with a custom OpenAI-compatible provider and use Qubrid from the TUI, web UI, or channels.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/OpenClaw) [Grok Build\\

## [Web interfaces](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Connect%20Your%20Tools\#web-interfaces)

Host your own chat UI and load models from Qubrid.

[Open WebUI\\
\\
Connect Open WebUI admin settings to Qubrid and chat with serverless models in your browser.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Open%20WebUI) [Dify\\
\\
Install the Qubrid AI plugin and use serverless models in Dify apps, agents, and workflows.](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Dify)

## [Pick the right guide](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Connect%20Your%20Tools\#pick-the-right-guide)

| If you want to… | Start with |
| --- | --- |
| Code with AI in **Cursor** or **VS Code** | [Cursor](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Cursor) or [VS Code](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/VS%20Code) |
| Use **Cline** in your IDE or terminal | [Cline](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Cline) |
| Use **Zed** as your editor | [Zed](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Zed) |
| Run **Claude Code** on Qubrid OSS models | [Claude Code](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Claude%20Code) |
| Deploy a **personal agent** with messaging support | [Hermes](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Hermes) or [OpenClaw](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/OpenClaw) |
| Use **Grok Build** in the terminal with Qubrid models | [Grok Build](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Grok%20Build) |
| Self-host a **web chat** interface | [Open WebUI](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Open%20WebUI) |
| Build **LLM apps and workflows** in Dify | [Dify](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Integrations/Dify) |

Browse the full model catalog and pricing on [Serverless Models](https://qubrid.com/models) before choosing which models to connect.
